welcome_message.name: Welcome Message
welcome_message.description: Auto-reply to first-time contacts with a greeting.
welcome_message.message: Hi! 👋 Thanks for reaching out. We'll get back to you shortly.

out_of_office.name: Out of Office
out_of_office.description: Auto-reply during off-hours so nobody is left waiting.
out_of_office.message: Thanks for your message! Our team is offline right now (9am–6pm) and will reply first thing tomorrow.

lead_qualifier.name: Lead Qualifier
lead_qualifier.description: Ask qualification questions to filter inbound leads.
lead_qualifier.message: Great — happy to help with pricing! Quick question: roughly how many seats are you looking for?

followup_no_reply_2h.name: No-reply follow-up (2 h)
followup_no_reply_2h.description: If the customer doesn't reply within 2 hours, we write to pick the conversation back up.
followup_no_reply_2h.message: Hi! 👋 Did you get a chance to look at what we sent? If you have any questions, I'm here to help.

followup_last_call_23h.name: Last call before 24 h
followup_last_call_23h.description: After 23 h without a reply, the AI writes one last message before WhatsApp's 24-hour window closes.
followup_last_call_23h.instructions: This is the last message we can send before the conversation closes. Pick up what the customer needed and ask if they want to continue.

followup_winback_3d.name: Win back customer (3 days, template)
followup_winback_3d.description: After 3 days without a reply the 24-hour window is closed, so we send an approved WhatsApp template.

appointment_booking.name: Doctor Appointment Booking
appointment_booking.description: Auto-reply to patient booking requests and route them to your clinic staff.
appointment_booking.message:
Hello! 🏥 Thank you for contacting our clinic. To request an appointment, please reply with:

1. Patient's Full Name
2. Preferred Specialty / Doctor
3. Preferred Date & Time

You can also view our schedule and book directly here: https://example.com/booking
appointment_booking.keywords: book, appointment, doctor, slot, clinic, visit, checkup
